title: Mobile & Offline Apps
description: Build responsive mobile applications with offline capabilities, synchronization, and native device integration

content.introduction: Modern PEGA applications must provide seamless mobile experiences with offline capabilities. This lesson covers mobile-first design, offline synchronization, native device integration, and performance optimization for mobile environments.

sections.title: Mobile-First Design Principles
sections.content: Design applications specifically for mobile devices with touch interfaces, limited screen real estate, and varying connectivity. Understand mobile UX patterns and responsive design strategies.

sections.title: Offline Data Management
sections.content: Implement robust offline data management including local storage, synchronization strategies, conflict resolution, and data consistency across devices.

sections.title: Native Device Integration
sections.content: Integrate with native device features including camera, GPS, contacts, push notifications, and biometric authentication for enhanced mobile experiences.

sections.title: Network Connectivity Handling
sections.content: Handle varying network conditions gracefully with offline mode detection, automatic synchronization, and user feedback for connectivity issues.

sections.title: Performance Optimization
sections.content: Optimize mobile application performance through efficient data loading, image optimization, caching strategies, and battery usage optimization.

sections.title: Testing and Deployment
sections.content: Test mobile applications across different devices, operating systems, and network conditions. Understand deployment strategies for app stores and enterprise distribution.
